style.name: Lữ Khách
style.prompt: cute storybook children's game art, soft painterly shading with clean dark-brown outlines, warm friendly colors, rounded shapes, gentle hopeful lighting, wholesome, not scary

hero.prompt: a cheerful young traveler child about 10 years old with short dark hair, a simple green tunic with a brown belt, brown boots, a small brown backpack with a rolled blanket, holding a wooden walking staff, seen exactly from the side facing right, full body, standing

hero-sword.prompt: the same child now holding a glowing golden sword of light pointing forward in a brave ready stance instead of the staff, still seen exactly from the side facing right

hero-hurt.prompt: the same child sitting down after slipping in mud, a little embarrassed but okay, mud splashes on the boots, still seen from the side facing right

hero-cheer.prompt: the same child jumping for joy with both arms raised, big smile, still seen from the side facing right

boss-hit.prompt: the same mud blob flinching from a bright warm light, eyes squeezed shut, mud splattering, small sparkles of light around it

boss-defeated.prompt: the same mud blob melted into a flat calm puddle with a small relieved smile, the rain cloud is gone, a few little flowers sprouting beside it

lantern-on.prompt: the same lantern now lit with a warm glowing golden flame inside and a soft glow around it

hero-bow.prompt: the same child now holding a simple wooden bow drawn back with a golden arrow ready, aiming forward and slightly upward, brave focused face, no staff, still seen exactly from the side facing right

hero-reach.prompt: the same child reaching both arms straight up high to catch something falling from the sky, looking up with a hopeful smile, no staff, still seen exactly from the side facing right

boss.prompt: a big cute sad blob monster made of brown swamp mud, droopy sleepy eyes, a pouting frown, mud dripping from its round soft body, a tiny grey rain cloud above its head, harmless and gloomy, not scary

sign.prompt: an empty wide wooden signboard made of one horizontal plank on a short post, blank with no text, front view

stone.prompt: a wide flat round grey stepping stone with a little moss, seen from the side at a low angle, blank

lantern-off.prompt: an old brass hanging lantern with glass panes, unlit, front view

shield.prompt: a round golden shield with a simple cross emblem in the center, glowing softly, front view

sword.prompt: a glowing golden sword of light, diagonal, simple and elegant

rock.prompt: a round falling boulder of dark volcanic rock with glowing orange cracks and a short trail of little embers above it, cartoon, not scary

scroll.prompt: a wide open parchment scroll held horizontally with rolled ends on the left and right, cream paper, blank with no text, soft golden glow around it, front view

slab.prompt: a wide flat floating stone slab platform, thin and rectangular, a strip of green grass on top, a few small pebbles crumbling from its underside, seen from the side, blank

crow.prompt: a cute cartoon black crow flying with wings spread wide, round body, big mischievous eyes, small orange beak, seen exactly from the side facing right, funny and not scary

arrow.prompt: a simple wooden arrow with a shiny golden arrowhead and white feather fletching, perfectly horizontal pointing right

backgrounds.bg-run: a misty swamp marsh in soft morning light, side view panorama, a long muddy dirt path along the bottom third crossing the whole image from left to right, reeds, small pools and a few low trees, distant hills, the left and right edges look alike so the picture can repeat horizontally
backgrounds.bg-river: a wide slough of murky brown-green water seen from the side, light mist over the water, reeds at the edges, a grassy bank far on the right, soft light, calm and empty in the middle
backgrounds.bg-night: a quiet swamp forest path at night in deep blue tones, fireflies, light mist, calm and peaceful, not scary, empty foreground
backgrounds.bg-boss: a large mud pit in a swamp clearing under grey clouds, one warm ray of sunlight breaking through the clouds, empty center, wide view
backgrounds.bg-map: a storybook adventure map of a misty swamp region seen from above at an angle, a small village at the bottom left, a winding dirt path with little wooden bridges crossing marshes and a dark muddy pool in the middle, leading to a small wooden gate at the top right
backgrounds.bg-sinai: a huge dark rocky mountain rising on the right side under swirling purple-grey storm clouds, small flashes of lightning, a few glowing embers in the air, a flat open sandy rocky ground along the bottom fifth crossing the whole image, wide side view, open empty sky in the upper middle, dramatic but gentle and child-friendly
backgrounds.bg-cliff: high mountain cliffs in bright morning sun, a deep chasm full of soft white clouds far below, distant blue peaks, a few birds, wide side view panorama, open sky, empty middle, the left and right edges look alike so the picture can repeat horizontally
backgrounds.bg-gate: a narrow wooden gate in a tall old stone wall on the left side with a warm golden light glowing above the gate, a meadow with a dirt path at the bottom, a dark crooked castle tower on a hill in the far right distance with tiny crows circling it, sunset sky in orange and purple, open sky in the middle, wide side view
backgrounds.bg-map2: a storybook adventure map seen from above at an angle: at the bottom left the edge of a misty swamp, a winding dirt path climbing up past a tall smoking rocky mountain in the left middle, then across narrow cliffs over a cloudy chasm in the center, to a small narrow wooden gate in a long stone wall at the top right, a dark crooked tower with crows on a hill near the gate, soft warm colors
